appliesTo: All advised investment and pension cases

queries.text: suitability report recommendation summary for the client

triggerProbe.presentWhen: At least one category I document is returned.
triggerProbe.absentWhen: No category I passage exists in the case.
triggerProbe.note: Scope is factual consistency only. Do not assess suitability of recommendations, attitude to risk, capacity for loss, knowledge and experience, investment suitability or product selection rationale — those are CHK-002 to CHK-004 and CHK-006 to CHK-009.

queryGroups.requirement: Essential facts (personal details) stated in the report are consistent with the evidence

queries.text: your current situation you are currently aged and married with children
client personal details date of birth marital status national insurance number
dependants children financially dependent living at home
health status smoker in good health medical conditions

comparison.tolerance: Age may differ by 1 year where the fact find predates the report; date of birth must match exactly.
falsePositiveGuards: The report often states age while the fact find states date of birth — derive before comparing, using the report date.
A spouse who is not the advised client appears in both documents; do not treat their details as a mismatch on the client.

sufficiency.ifAssertionAbsent: Not a finding on its own — a report need not restate every personal detail.
sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Potential Concern: the report asserts personal facts with no supporting KYC record.

queryGroups.requirement: Tax status stated in the report is consistent with the evidence

queries.text: your marginal rate of income tax basic rate higher rate taxpayer personal allowance
money purchase annual allowance triggered annual allowance carry forward lifetime allowance protection
tax residency domicile UK resident for tax purposes

falsePositiveGuards: Generic legislative statements of allowance limits are not client-specific assertions; only flag where a figure is applied to this client.
Scottish and rest-of-UK bands differ — check territorial profile before flagging a band mismatch.

sufficiency.ifAssertionAbsent: Note as a gap where the recommendation depends on tax band (encashment, contribution relief, drawdown).
sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Potential Concern: tax treatment asserted without a recorded tax position.

queryGroups.requirement: Employment details are consistent with the evidence

queries.text: you work full time as employed self employed occupation employer earning
intended retirement age expect to retire in years selected retirement date

falsePositiveGuards: Intended retirement age in a fact find is often superseded by a later file note — prefer the most recent dated evidence.

sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Potential Concern where employment income underpins affordability.

queryGroups.requirement: Income and expenditure figures are consistent with the evidence

queries.text: your income per week per month net earnings from employment
income and expenditure schedule monthly net income total outgoings surplus
household expenditure rent mortgage utilities food transport insurance per month
essential expenditure versus discretionary spending breakdown

comparison.tolerance: Normalise to a monthly equivalent before comparing. Treat a difference of more than 5% as a mismatch; below that, rounding.
falsePositiveGuards: Gross versus net is the single most common false mismatch — never compare a gross fact-find figure to a net report figure.
Weekly figures annualise at 52, not 4.33 x 12; £300/week is £1,300/month, not £1,200.
A report giving one consolidated household expenditure figure cannot be reconciled line by line — compare on the total only.

sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Potential Concern: unsupported figures. This is the check's stated core - 'data mismatches and unsupported figures'.

queryGroups.requirement: Assets and liabilities are consistent with the evidence

queries.text: assets and liabilities table net asset value savings cash property
outstanding mortgage loans credit cards debts no outstanding liabilities
main residence home value owned rented
queries.note: Reconciles the assets table against any property assumed in cashflow modelling.

falsePositiveGuards: An assets table that excludes pensions is normal — check whether pensions are listed separately before flagging an omission.
Valuation dates differ between fact find and report; compare as-at dates before flagging a value difference.

sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Potential Concern where the asset position supports the capacity-for-loss or affordability conclusion.

queryGroups.requirement: State pension entitlement is consistent with the evidence

queries.text: state pension entitlement full new state pension per week in payment
state pension forecast age qualifying years from age 66 67

comparison.tolerance: Weekly and annual statements of the same entitlement must reconcile at x52.
falsePositiveGuards: State pension age and intended retirement age are different things and are routinely conflated in reports.

sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Potential Concern: state pension entitlement is named explicitly by this check and is often asserted without a forecast on file.

queryGroups.requirement: Existing products (pensions, investments and protection plans) are consistent with the evidence

queries.text: existing arrangements table provider policy number fund value transfer value
policy information current fund value as at valuation date plan number
transfer value quotation surrender value cash equivalent
regular contributions paid by member and employer per month annual
total combined pension value across all plans
queries.note: Cross-foots the narrative total against the per-plan table. Discrepancies here are pure internal inconsistencies and need no external evidence.

queries.text: existing life cover income protection critical illness policy sum assured premium
queries.note: Protection plans are named explicitly alongside pensions and investments; check sum assured and premium the same way a pension's fund value is checked.

queries.text: fund holdings underlying investments within the existing plan percentage allocation
queries.note: Reconciles named holdings in the report against the plan's holdings statement, not just the top-line value.

comparison.tolerance: Plan values must match the provider statement to the penny where the same as-at date is used; otherwise flag the date gap, not the value.
falsePositiveGuards: Fund value and transfer value are different figures; a report quoting one against a statement quoting the other is not automatically a mismatch.
Values move between the provider statement date and the report date — check both dates before flagging.
A protection plan has no fund value to reconcile — compare sum assured and premium instead.

sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Potential Concern: plan values quoted with no provider documentation to support them.

queryGroups.requirement: Data mismatches and unsupported figures within the report itself

queries.text: total transfer value into the new plan recommended solution amount invested
queries.note: Compare against the sum of the individual plans in G1.7 and against any narrative total.

queries.text: charges percentage and monetary amount per existing plan comparison table
queries.note: Recompute each monetary charge against the stated plan value; a figure that is not the stated percentage of the stated value is an unsupported figure.

queries.text: worked example calculation estimated net receipt after tax
queries.note: Checks worked examples against the plan values quoted elsewhere in the same report.

comparison.tolerance: Arithmetic must reconcile within rounding to the nearest pound or 0.01%.
falsePositiveGuards: A figure quoted 'as at' an earlier date is not an inconsistency; look for a stated date before flagging.

sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Not applicable — this group compares the report against itself.

queryGroups.requirement: Emergency fund figures stated in the report are consistent with the evidence

queries.text: you hold an emergency fund of in cash instant access savings
queries.note: This tests only whether the figure the report states matches the fact find — CHK-005 separately tests whether the amount is adequate.

queries.text: cash savings balance instant access account statement balance

falsePositiveGuards: Cash held for a known planned purchase is not part of the emergency fund even if it sits in the same account — check the stated purpose before comparing totals.
Do not assess whether the emergency fund is sufficient here — that is CHK-005; only test whether the report's figure matches the evidenced balance.

sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Potential Concern: an emergency fund figure asserted with no supporting account statement or fact find record.

decision.noIssue: Every group with an assertion side found corroborating evidence in at least one of categories A, B, C or E, values reconcile within tolerance, and no internal arithmetic contradiction was found.
decision.potentialConcern: Any material client fact, financial figure, plan value or holding asserted in the report either contradicts the evidence or has no supporting document; or the report contradicts itself on a figure it relies on. Do not raise a finding on the suitability of recommendations, attitude to risk, capacity for loss, knowledge and experience, investment suitability or product selection rationale — those are CHK-002 to CHK-004 and CHK-006 to CHK-009.
decision.notApplicable: No category I document exists for this case.
severityHints: Highest: a figure that drives the recommendation (transfer value, charge, income need) contradicts the provider or fact-find evidence.
High: the report contradicts itself on the same figure in two places — no external evidence needed to conclude.
Moderate: a personal or contextual detail differs with no bearing on the recommendation.
Low: rounding, presentation or as-at date differences.
